title: Successor machine run
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, and choose a work-tape index $i$. Suppose a configuration $d$ starts in the successor machine's increment phase, and tape $i$ agrees with the buffered word $w$ at every offset from $-1$ through $|w|+1$. Then there is a time $t\le 4|w|+14$ at which the machine first reaches its exit phase. At that time, tape $i$ contains the successor word of $w$ on the cells beginning at its original head position, and all other tape cells and configuration data are unchanged. Up to time $t$, every work-tape head stays within distance $|w|+4$ of its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: natural number $k$ and Boolean input word $x$
initial state is the successor machine's increment phase
tape $i$ agrees with the buffered word at offsets $-1$ through $|w|+1$
